summary: The latest branch is oodialog-qt6-v0.9, renderer v0.9.0, based on and tested against oodialog-wasm 71f3590 (v0.18.0). All 48 of the suite's tests pass, both offscreen and on an X server (Xvfb with Qt's xcb platform, as a desktop runs it). New in v0.9.0: tool tips (v0.18.0: toolTip, customPositionToolTip, manageControlTool, and t12_tips, which now checks the tip box). In v0.8.0: the month calendar (v0.16.0), ResizingAdmin and the editable combo's edit (v0.17.0). A program that ends before its steps are done fails. The suite is the browser harness's tests, with their .steps and .expect files, plus the three programs the ooDialog Designer generates (Calculator, Contacts, Gadgets; see sphere oodialog-designer), used unchanged as a contract test. Every one of upstream's sample programs was also started with nothing clicked: against v0.18.0, 83 of 122 programs showed their dialog (81 against v0.17.0, 77 against v0.15.0). All 35 errors were in oodWeb.cls's scope; none was in the renderer: winsystm.cls 19, resource reader not set 8, ooDialog native functions oodWeb does not have yet 5, other 3. Since 15 Nov 2026 this chat owns Linux ooDialog (Tom's rule). Earlier branches and their oodialog-wasm bases: v0.2 2c861d8, v0.3 23d57b2, v0.4 155e1b0, v0.5 1d89981, v0.6 0e0e744, v0.7 fc16dfb, v0.8 2423db8.
